# Crawlers only read robots.txt from the domain root, and this is a GitHub
# Pages *project* site: the file they fetch is yohimik.github.io/robots.txt,
# which belongs to the user-page repository, not to this one. So the copy served
# at /dispat/robots.txt is advisory until the site gets its own domain, and what
# actually gets the pages crawled is the sitemap below (submit it once in
# Search Console; it is generated on every build by @docusaurus/plugin-sitemap).
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Search results are a client-side view of the index, not content.
Disallow: /dispat/search

Sitemap: https://yohimik.github.io/dispat/sitemap.xml
